interpretations: Group all sentiment and fundamentals snapshots by `eventannotm`, including a separate group for missing timing. For each group, average the nonmissing `instownpct` values. Compute the baseline as the unweighted average of those group averages. Return one row with the average of the group averages strictly above the baseline and their average excess over the baseline, without rounding
queries:
WITH timing_groups AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS baseline_avg
  FROM timing_groups
)
SELECT
  AVG(group_avg) AS above_baseline_avg,
  AVG(group_avg - baseline_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM timing_groups
CROSS JOIN baseline
WHERE group_avg > baseline_avg
